messages:
Rae (People Ops): Exception request: candidate Ibrahim Khan for Staff Product Manager. Manager requested compband M4 (guideline M3) and a $28k sign-on. Candidate also asked for an HRA (health reimbursement) to cover interim COBRA costs and an early start 2026-04-20. Need approvals + benefits effective date clarification.
Ibrahim (Hiring Mgr): M4 is warranted based on cross-org scope. 4/20 start important to hit PM kickoff. We can own retention check at 9 months.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate can start 4/20 if notice wraps up. He wants HRA to bridge benefits; asked if HRA can be paid within first 30 days.
Olga (Compben): Policy notes: HRA requests handled case-by-case; need business justification. Sign-on > $25k requires VP approval. HRA taxable treatment depends on structure; payroll will advise. Please post total comp and proposed payout schedule.
Rae (People Ops): Proposed package below:
```
base: $160,000
bonus (target): $20,000
sign-on: $28,000 (14k immediate, 14k at 9 months contingent on employment)
HRA bridge: up to $3,200 (reimbursement for COBRA premiums)
equity: $80,000 4yr
total disclosed year1 cash (incl immediate sign-on and HRA max): $197,200
```
Connor (Finance): Need to know if HRA is taxable reimbursement or paid as expense. If taxable, we need to gross-up? We don't gross-up standard HRAs. Finance recommends HRA be set up as expense reimbursement with receipts to avoid gross-up. For sign-on, we can do 14k immediate; remainder at 9 months. Need GL codes.
Ibrahim (Hiring Mgr): Manager is OK with receipts-based HRA. Need candidate clarity so he can sign.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate asked if benefits medical coverage can start day 1 or first payroll. For 4/20 start, benefits admin cutoff may make effective date 5/1. Can we confirm?
Olga (Compben): Benefits effective: typical rule first of month after start unless candidate starts before admin cutoff and we can manually enroll same-day. For 4/20 likely 5/1, but I'll check admin cutoff (end of month 4/28 for benefits ops). Will confirm.
offer-bot: Offer GH-77661 drafted. Routing people-ops -> compben -> finance -> vp-people.
Rae (People Ops): Tagging @Nina for M4 + sign-on >25k approval and HRA exception. Nina?
Nina (VP People): Thanks. Please share leveling memo and market comp. Approving M4 if leveling and compbench justify. HRA approval contingent on receipts-only reimbursement and cap at $3,200. Approving $28k sign-on with 14k immediate + 14k at 9 months conditioned on continued employment and manager verification. Require manager to log 9-month objectives in Lattice. Approving now :white_check_mark:
